You will be working in the horticultural sector at a company that specializes in the cultivation and production of potted roses. The company uses modern, automated systems to produce plants efficiently and in accordance with high-quality standards. 
Activities - Operating and monitoring plant and production machinery - Supporting the cultivation of roses and flowers - Loading machines with plant material - Checking the quality of plants and flowers - Identifying and reporting malfunctions or anomalies 
 Activities 
 - Ensuring a smooth and precise production process - Working in accordance with established quality and work instructions - Handling machinery and equipment with precision and responsibility 
 We are looking for someone who: 
 - Available for at least 3 months - Willing to work in a greenhouse - Works with precision and takes responsibility - has a basic knowledge of English - Is flexible and willing to work shifts
